Document Management System
==========================

This is a sample document for testing purposes.

Introduction
------------
The Document Management System (DMS) is a comprehensive solution for managing documents in social services planning. It provides tools for document processing, search, analysis, and quality assessment.

Key Features:
- Document parsing and text extraction
- Semantic search capabilities
- Quality assessment tools
- GDPR-compliant anonymization
- Named Entity Recognition (NER)
- Document comparison and versioning

Technical Details
-----------------
The system is built using Python 3.9+ and leverages machine learning libraries such as spaCy, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow for advanced text processing.
